claims.statement: Explorer, headless reports, and PR compare are equally important consumers; one shared metric definition should drive all three.
Work happens now as a stack of PRs: fix issues first, then improve the system.
All four research initiatives are in scope now, not gated behind each other.
Cut boldly: remove misleading risk directions and noisy metrics now, with no compatibility layer.
The agent runs the portfolio pilot itself on local repos and adjudicates cases; Byron is minimally available. Use consider-contrast for consequential choices.
Must have an excellent single-metric hotspot list. Add a two-axis scatter with a named 2x2 quadrant model.
Keep React/TSX-specific metrics that help target React and TSX refactors; choose the set by consider-contrast instead of deleting them all.
Excessive comments matter now (AI-era over-commenting); the low-comments penalty is the wrong direction. TODOs are low priority.
Srcly must just work: run lint/type tools itself with no bespoke config, rather than import user-supplied artifacts. Lint/type findings are in scope.
Ship several named 2x2 scatter presets (e.g. activity, blast radius, React component weight, comment noise) rather than one fixed pair.
Excessive comments = high comment ratio, docblocks much longer than the body, and commented-out code, judged against absolute thresholds, never the repo norm.
Findings use project tsc/eslint when present, otherwise Srcly bundled defaults (ruff for Python, built-in tree-sitter rules for TS), labelled by which ran.

Stack order confirmed: trust fixes, catalog cuts + comment flip, single-metric list + shared definitions, Git activity on by default, 2x2 presets, findings, local-repo pilot. Clones and coverage below the cut line.

shape.problem: Metrics conflate zero with N/A, rank inconsistently across surfaces, score some fields in the wrong direction, and lack activity/comment-noise/component/finding signals.
shape.recommended_shape: Trust fixes, one server-owned catalog, bold cuts plus comment-noise and component metrics, single-metric list, Git activity, 2x2 presets, zero-config findings, agent-run pilot.
success_moves: Trust before signals so new data is not read as zero
Single server catalog removes three hand-mirrored tables
Reuse compare git_refs runner for activity
External tools behind one runner with timeout -> N/A
Absolute comment thresholds tuned by pilot
Agent-run hybrid pilot replaces human-gated review
